packages.title: Documentation aligned with the charter
acceptance: Scope: the term scan finds EKF, ROS 2, MoveIt, PL/SIL, CTO, system decision authority, differential end effector and trajectory planning only in the allowed contexts (plan section 3.1)
Numbers: every number in a normative document is a contract constant or a PRM-* row with a basis; SYSTEM_REQUIREMENTS.md holds no numbers (3.2)
Requirements: a baseline of about 15 to 20 SYS-* rows (17 accepted 2026-10-03), each from a charter goal, with an acceptance criterion and a matrix row; retired IDs listed with successors (3.3)
Interfaces: nothing Stages 1 to 4 need is TBD, not frozen or proposed; anything open is scoped to a later stage (3.4)
Trail: every live register item maps to one open GitHub issue; milestones are stages; closed-as-not-planned issues cite the non-goal (3.5; GitHub changes held for Lenton Neale)
Size: documentation about documentation at most 250 lines; the register at most 150 lines; no section README stubs; For_Lenton retired (3.6)
Links: every relative link in the three documentation trees resolves; docs/project and 99_ARCHIVE appear only in the index provenance line (3.7)
Lockstep: every wire-format change in a document has an issue for the C side, the Python side and their tests, and says not yet implemented until it is (3.8)
Sign-off: Lenton Neale walks the list and records the date in ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md; the PASS at this Requirements gate is that sign-off and tags baseline/requirements/v1 (3.9)
Drafted outside the Portal on branch docs/charter-alignment (sprints 0 to 6, 2026-10-03); the Portal tracks the sign-off from here

packages.title: Stage 1: fitted encoders
acceptance: NOT_FITTED on the wire (validity bit 6) implemented in spi_payload_layout.h, spi_protocol.c, spi_protocol.py and both test suites (SYS-ENC-002)
Encoder-fitted flag in the app_init.c commissioning table; the sensor task skips unfitted axes without raising a fault
Commissioning table in SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION.md section 2.1 filled by Lenton Neale: joint names, which axes have an encoder; app_init.c matches it (SYS-ENC-003)
One evidence record per fitted axis (EVIDENCE_RECORD_FORMAT.md, VERSION identity) accepted in SYSTEM_VERIFICATION_MATRIX.md (SYS-ENC-001)
Register item LIVE-17 and its GitHub issues closed

Reopened 2026-10-14 by ruling R29(b): still unmet are one accepted evidence record per fitted axis and LIVE-17 closed; the records are taken in WP16 Stage 1 and filed against this package; no waiver recorded

packages.title: Stage 2: motor positions and coherent timestamps
acceptance: All commissioned motors registered in app_init.c and polled; every motor record in the snapshot (SYS-MOT-001)
Clock sync per Issue #12: ISR raw capture, request_received_local_us, Pi-side ClockSync, TIME_SYNC removed (SYS-SYNC-001, SYS-TS-001; GitHub #42)
DIAGNOSTIC v2 and GET_DIAGNOSTIC implemented for fault visibility (SAFE-05)
Bench evidence at rest and during motion accepted in the matrix for SYS-MOT-001, SYS-MOT-002 and SYS-TS-001
Register items LIVE-18 and LIVE-19 closed

packages.title: Stage 3: links measured
acceptance: Measured with an evidence record each: SPI clock and cable, CAN bitrate and bus load, sync skew and timestamp conversion error, poll periods, per-axis latency, DATA_READY GPIO on the Pi (LIVE-22)
PARAMETER_REGISTER.md rows move from Provisional to Measured with the record linked; no value changes basis without evidence
CAN bitrate decided from the measurement: PRM-CAN-02 (as generated) kept or PRM-CAN-03 applied, recorded in ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md
Firmware and Pi parameters centralised in one header and one config that mirror the register
Every evidence record carries the firmware identity from the VERSION message; timing-harness outputs filed as evidence

packages.title: Stage 4: gated motion X, Y, Z
acceptance: SET_MOTOR_COMMAND path implemented: SPI decode, gate, MKS command on CAN, ACK or NACK with the gate reason, in C, Python and tests (SYS-CMD-001)
motion_permission.c simplified to SYS-GATE-001 with the count-based link_stale liveness check (SYS-LINK-001)
Initial movement records for joints X, Y and Z written and dated by Lenton Neale
Matrix rows Joint X, Y and Z verified motion reach SYSTEM_VERIFIED: gated command ACKed with motion visible in the snapshot, stop on link loss observed
SAFE-01 to SAFE-05 evidence accepted; register items LIVE-20 and LIVE-21 closed

packages.title: Stage 5: remaining joints
acceptance: Hardware for joints 4, 5 and 6 confirmed and recorded in the commissioning table (names, encoder fitted, motor, CAN ID)
Each of the three joints verified as for X, Y and Z: movement record, gated command, stop on link loss
Matrix rows for joints 4 to 6 reach SYSTEM_VERIFIED

packages.title: Architecture and component documentation aligned
acceptance: Layers reviewed top down, one Portal run per layer, each reviewed read-only against the merged layers above (CHARTER_ALIGNMENT_PLAN.md section 15): L2 architecture and interfaces, L3 system components and configuration, L4 component implementation docs, L5 verification
Each layer review has no open major finding (contradicts, exceeds, redefines) without a ruling by Lenton Neale
Lower-layer runs leave upper-layer files unchanged; a fault found above becomes a story for that layer
GET_DIAGNOSTIC scoped to a stage in SPI_SYSTEM_INTERFACE.md and SPI_PAYLOAD_SCHEMA.md (plan 3.4)
Starts after the WP1 Requirements gate PASS; the Architecture gate PASS tags baseline/architecture/v1, and code-alignment WP2 to WP6 start after it
GitHub trail (plan 3.5 and 3.8) runs after L5 as its own short run; GitHub changes held for Lenton Neale

packages.title: Code checked against the baselined documentation
acceptance: Seven audit areas reviewed read-only, one Portal run each: SPI wire format, CAN and MKS, time and sync, lifecycle/health/gate, parameters, Pi host and tools, trail
Each area is checked against baseline/requirements/v1 and baseline/architecture/v1 and the documents that own it; no code or documentation file is edited

Every finding is a backlog story with: kind (Add, Remove, Change, Doc fault, Unknown), the SYS-*/SAFE-*/PRM-* item or contract clause, charter goal (1 to 5), files touched, bench-blocking yes/no, and size
Every Doc fault finding has a ruling by Lenton Neale; every Unknown is a question for Lenton Neale, recorded as unknown and never invented
CHARTER_ALIGNMENT_PLAN.md sections 2.4 and 11 point at the WP8 stories instead of holding their own list

Ends with the code-alignment packages re-cut from the bench-blocking stories, each targeting Implementation (host tests and Debug build pass, bench procedure and empty evidence record ready), plus one Bench bring-up and verification package for when the arm is connected

packages.title: Foundation and trail integrity (Stage 0: before any bench run)
acceptance: Firmware identity taken at build time, including the compiler version; a dirty tree always reports dirty (SPI-19, FW-3, VER-39; R28a)
Default task stack sized from measured usage with overflow checking on (FW-2, PRM-9)
Shared golden-frame vectors in shared/test-vectors asserted by both the C and Python suites (SPI-10, VER-23)
MksServo codec host tests restored and checked against the vendor manual (CAN-26, VER-24)
Evidence-record tool writes a record per EVIDENCE_RECORD_FORMAT.md with VERSION identity and Pi commit (VER-40)
One firmware parameter header and one Pi config module mirror the register; CubeMX-owned values checked at init (PRM-24, PRM-25)
CI runs doc_check, cross-triggers on lockstep files, uploads .map, fails on App warnings, pins the system arm-none-eabi-gcc used for evidence builds (VER-50, VER-52, VER-53, FW-27, FW-28; R28a)
Dead Pi tests and dead codec removed; host-test harness fixes landed (VER-16, VER-17, VER-34 to VER-37)
HostTests and Debug build pass

packages.title: Stage 1 code: fitted encoders on the wire
acceptance: GET_SNAPSHOT is answered with a correlated SNAPSHOT carrying the six sensor records and registered motor records (SPI-1, FW-1, VER-21)
SPI service never wedges after stage-while-armed, HAL arm failure or stall-abort race; stall re-arms the same frame (SPI-2, SPI-13)
DATA_READY follows C-1 armed-then-assert on the STM32 and the Pi waits for a fresh edge (SPI-3, HOST-7, HOST-8)
Pi snapshot logger streams GET_SNAPSHOT at the registered period, rejects duplicates, files records with Pi receive times (SPI-6, HOST-3)
Sequence seeding no longer locks later processes out (HOST-9)
Sensor timestamp taken immediately after the angle read (TIME-6, FW-9)
Stage 1 host and Pi tests listed in the A7 plan pass; ENCODER_BENCH_PROCEDURE covers SYS-ENC-002 and is indexed (VER-22, VER-30, VER-33, DOC-5, DOC-9)
HostTests, Debug build and Pi tests pass; empty evidence records ready for the five fitted axes

packages.title: Stage 2 code: six motor positions over CAN
acceptance: CAN bit timing set to 1 Mbit/s (PRM-CAN-03 applied, R9a), one symbol checked at init; each drive's CAN ID, model, firmware (40H), work mode, response mode, FFH and 85H settings read by Lenton Neale and recorded in SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION §2.1 before commissioning (CAN-1, CAN-3, PRM-1; R9b, R25a)
Six motors registered from one validated table with duplicate/broadcast rejection and a table version (CAN-18, CAN-19, CAN-20)
CAN polling and draining independent of the sensor sweep; every registered motor polled each cycle (CAN-17, PRM-4, FW-16)
RX interrupt captures reception time; motor record keeps position separate from speed and acks; decoder status fixed (CAN-14, CAN-15, CAN-16)
Feedback timeout and miss escalation per PRM-MOT-01/02 with the feedback period registered (CAN-12, CAN-13, GATE-22)

Bus-off detected from hardware, lifecycle leaves ACTIVE, recovery judged by ESR, queue purged; after escalation to ERROR no automatic retry until the system-activate message (CAN-4 to CAN-8, GATE-17 to GATE-19; R12)
Pi decodes motor records (31H int48), DIAGNOSTIC v1 and GET_DIAGNOSTIC (0x15); motor validity bits and status defined in the schema (SPI-4, SPI-5, SPI-11, HOST-2, HOST-4, DOC-4; R10, R14)
Stage 2 host tests pass and MOTOR_BENCH_PROCEDURE.md is written (VER-28, VER-29, VER-41)
HostTests, Debug build and Pi tests pass

packages.title: Stage 2 code: clock synchronisation per Issue #12
acceptance: Implements ruling R16 (a) to (j): T4, applicable replies, extension placement, Pi clock domain and reset detection (TIME-11 to TIME-14, SPI-9)
ISR raw TIM2 capture extended in task context with the PRM-TS-04 guard; request_received_local_us on the wire in C and Python (TIME-1, TIME-2)
Pi ClockSync model fed by TimingSession; record timestamps converted and marked (TIME-3, TIME-4, TIME-5, HOST-5)
STM32 TIME_SYNC, held offset and legacy Pi chain removed in one lockstep change; sync-quality bits and health GREEN re-sourced (TIME-8, TIME-9, TIME-19, HOST-17, GATE-24)
Gate A tests pass (VER-31); HostTests, Debug build and Pi tests pass

packages.title: Stage 3 code and tooling: links measured
acceptance: Timing harness sweeps poll period, classifies errors, derives the effective clock, records rig fields and link-loss timing; load workers scheduled correctly (HOST-6, HOST-10)
Register rows exist for every quantity Stage 3 measures, with PRM-SPI-03 split and the host polling period named (PRM-13, PRM-5, PRM-7, HOST-15)
LINK_MEASUREMENT_PROCEDURE.md and CAN_BUS_OFF_BENCH_PROCEDURE.md written against the instruments Lenton Neale names (VER-46, VER-43, VER-47)
Pi tests pass; empty evidence records ready for each PRM row in the register's Measurement stages list

packages.title: Stage 4 code: gated motion X, Y, Z
acceptance: Implements rulings R18 to R24 and R26(a): NACK reason codes per D-3 input, system motion lifecycle, motor_ready and global inhibit, stop policy, liveness values, prerequisites before gated motion (GATE-5, GATE-8, GATE-9, GATE-11 to GATE-13, SPI-8, CAN-22, DOC-6)
motion_permission.c built, simplified to D-3, per motor, side-effect free, the single motion authority (GATE-1, GATE-2, GATE-10, GATE-27, FW-4)
Count-based link_stale on STM32 local time with Provisional N symbols (GATE-3, TIME-15, PRM-10)
SET_MOTOR_COMMAND decoded, gated, mapped to MKS frames, ACKed or NACKed with the gate reason, in C, Python and golden vectors (SPI-7, CAN-21, HOST-1)

Fail-closed supervisor: controlled stop, then hold (stopped and enabled), on a gate-closed edge; queue purge; stop at boot and on CAN activation; MKS 98H heartbeat configured (GATE-6, GATE-7, GATE-14, CAN-23; R21d after WP17, R23)
Fault visibility: health snapshot fields and SWD readout for SAFE-05 (GATE-23, VER-14)

New system-activate SPI message (value proposed 0x16) with ACK/NACK in C, Python and golden vectors: activates services in dependency order, then the motion lifecycle; clears the global inhibit and the health YELLOW latch (R19b, R12d, R20b, R27)
Calibration is not part of this package (R26b): gated motion uses raw shaft angles; the calibration stories are in WP18
Stage 4 host tests pass; link-loss, gated-command and session-safety procedures written (VER-25 to VER-27, VER-32, VER-42, VER-44, VER-45)
HostTests, Debug build and Pi tests pass

packages.title: Documentation aligned with the code and the rulings

Timestamp semantics stated once; every time document marked as-built or target (DOC-3, DOC-10, DOC-11, TIME-22)
Matrix rows name only modules and tests that cover the row, or say none yet (VER-1, VER-4 to VER-9, DOC-26, HOST-29, TIME-24)
Register notes, Used-by and the Numbers rule corrected (PRM-6, DOC-36, DOC-19, PRM-27)
SPI contract gaps closed: NACK status table, request payload, padding, boot frame, motor flags (SPI-17, SPI-20, SPI-23, DOC-21, DOC-22)
Component documents match the code (HOST-26 to HOST-28, DOC-28 to DOC-31, DOC-35, DOC-40, VER-11 to VER-15)
doc_check clean; architecture gate re-passed and baseline/architecture/v2 tagged

packages.title: Bench bring-up and verification (when the arm is connected)
acceptance: Bench questions answered by rulings R17(a) instruments, R28(b) Pi dirty-tree rule and R28(c) Stage 2 motion source (VER-47 to VER-49)
Stage 1: WP2 holds the Stage 1 evidence; the records are taken here and filed against WP2 (VER-3, DOC-38; R29b)
Stage 2: motor position and feedback-interruption records accepted for SYS-MOT-001/002 and SYS-TS-001
Stage 3: every register row in the Measurement stages list moves to Measured with a linked record; PRM-CAN-02 recorded as applied

Stage 4: E-stop fitted and recorded first (R25b); SAFE-01 session check, link-loss stop with the shaft held and no later move, gated command per joint X, Y, Z; matrix rows reach SYSTEM_VERIFIED by Lenton Neale
Every record carries the VERSION identity from a clean build

packages.title: Requirements amendment: hold on link loss and retired IDs
acceptance: SAFE-02, SYS-LINK-002 and SYS-GATE-001 say the link-loss sequence ends with every joint stopped and enabled (shaft held); disable only on an operator DISABLE (R21d)
Retired IDs in SAFETY_REQUIREMENTS.md replaced with their successors in the same change (R29f)
SAFE-02 acceptance reads: stop observed, shaft held, no later move
doc_check clean; the Requirements gate re-passes and tags baseline/requirements/v2
Must pass before WP14 story B110 (fail-closed supervisor) is merged

packages.title: Calibration path (after the bench)
acceptance: Starts after WP16 (R26b); SYSTEM_CONFIGURATION §3 no longer requires calibration before gated motion
Calibration storage, transfer and reporting built; selection per SYS-CAL-001: the valid copy when one is valid, the newer when both are, fail only when neither is (FW-5 to FW-8, HOST-13; R26d)
Where the calibration version travels and the calibration transfer message are decided in this package (R26e, R26f)
HostTests, Debug build and Pi tests pass
